title: Resume a local-spec PR with a pending required check

rubric.text: Uses conversation-mode to-plan for the approved local source, reviews the resulting plan independently, and does not invent GitHub issue or ticket closing links
Reconciles the existing draft PR and exact head before continuing; does not create a duplicate PR or assume prior approval or gate state remains current
Obtains one fresh independent read-only review against the approved source, repository standards, and exact current PR head without requiring external code-review or issue-tracker setup
After about 30 minutes with a required check still pending, hands back the PR head and exact pending gate rather than reporting ready or merged
